# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul’s closing words to the Corinthians read like a battle cry. He doesn't say, "Relax, take it easy, and hope for the best." He commands us to watch—to be alert to the schemes of the enemy and the needs of our families. He tells us to stand fast, meaning we don't retreat when the pressure mounts. We hold our ground.

Men, your faith is not a passive shelter; it is an active fortress. You are the guardian of your home, your workplace, and your church. Being brave doesn't mean you don't feel fear; it means you move forward in obedience despite it. Being strong doesn't mean you never feel weak; it means you draw your strength from the One who never fails.

Today, you will face a choice: to drift with the current or to dig in your heels. Choose to stand firm. The Warrior King has already secured the victory. Your job is to hold the line He has entrusted to you.

## Daily Challenge
Identify one area where you've been retreating. Take one concrete step to advance today, and do 20 pushups as a physical reminder of your commitment to stand firm.
